editorial:
Imagine the world ending, but instead of hiding in a basement, you just keep drinking. That is the wild setup here. You follow two guys, played by Dave Anthony and Gareth Reynolds, who figure out that zombies only want people who are sober. To save the neighborhood, they decide to throw a massive, city-wide rager. It is a total blast from the start, mixing gross-out horror with the kind of goofy humor you would expect from a college party movie. The chemistry between the two leads is great, and the whole vibe feels like a chaotic celebration in the middle of a nightmare.

What really works is how the movie keeps the energy high without slowing down for too long. The action scenes are messy and funny, though some of the jokes might be a bit too silly for everyone. If you love movies that do not take themselves seriously, you will have a great time. You should definitely stream this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the gore in high detail, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you are a big fan of physical media, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your collection is a smart move for those re-watchable funny moments.
endingExplained: At the very end, the party gets crashed by a massive horde of zombies. The twist is that the main characters run out of beer, making everyone sober and vulnerable. Just as things look grim, they discover that high-sugar energy drinks work just as well as alcohol. They blast the speakers and lure the zombies into a giant swimming pool filled with booze, trapping them all. Everyone survives the night, and they decide to keep the party going forever.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves goofy horror and loud comedies.
